'As an additional cost to play this, discard a random card. / While this is defended by less than 2 non-equipment cards, it has go again.'

THE DISCARD IS A CARD-LEVEL `cost`, which play.py checks for legality and pays ONCE when the card is played. Never an ON_PLAY effect: a cost has to block the play, and modelling it as an effect would let the card be played with an empty hand and then discard nothing. Not an ability-level `additional_cost` either -- interpreter._run_ability pays those on every dispatch, which for the WHILE_STATIC below is every attack-power recalculation (breakneck_battery is the card that lesson came from).

'LESS THAN 2 NON-EQUIPMENT CARDS' is DEFENDING_CARD_COUNT with `equipment: false`, which counts only non-equipment defenders. Equipment defends for free every turn, so counting it would make the gate almost always false and the card almost never have go again.

SOURCE_IS_ATTACK does two jobs: it confines the static to THIS card's own attack, and it is what loader.conditional_keywords reads to strip the printed GoAgain. The card DB lists it unconditionally because it flattens the sentence; without the strip the gate is decoration and the attack always has go again.
